title: checksum-filter-png-only
userStory: As a mod developer, I want the folder checksum to only reflect PNG files so that non-image files in the atlas folder do not cause unnecessary atlas rebuilds.
background: WEChecksumUtils.ComputeFolderChecksum currently hashes ALL files in the folder. Only .png files are actually loaded by WEAtlasLoadingUtils, so the checksum should ignore all other files. For bridge-registered atlases coming from file paths, the full path must be part of the checksum (not just filename) because two mods can legitimately use identical image filenames. For memory-based producers (byte array producer), the checksum must cover: each entry's Name field and the total byte length of each array (Main, ControlMask, MaskMap, Normal, Emissive).
implementationNotes: 1. In WEChecksumUtils.ComputeFolderChecksum: add a filter to only include files matching *.png (case-insensitive) when sorting and hashing. Change the hashed string to use the full relative-or-absolute path instead of just the filename to accommodate bridge callers. 2. Add a new overload WEChecksumUtils.ComputeBridgeMemoryChecksum(IEnumerable<(string Name, byte[] Main, byte[] ControlMask, byte[] MaskMap, byte[] Normal, byte[] Emissive, string XmlInfo)> entries) — hashes Name + length of each non-null array per entry. 3. Update ComputeFolderChecksum callers in WEAtlasesLibrary to keep using the existing signature (folder path) — the path filtering change will take effect automatically.
dod: ComputeFolderChecksum hashes full path (not just filename) to support bridge callers with colliding names
New ComputeBridgeMemoryChecksum method added for producer-based atlases
New test: ComputeFolderChecksum_NonPngIgnored passes without Unity
